messages:
anya: quick heads-up: prototype for policy eval instrumentation ready. captures rule ids, score breakdowns, and optional explain blobs. sharing for feedback.

sam: rough perf hit?

anya: measured +4-7ms median, p95 +10-15ms when full explain assembled. memory overhead small per worker.

ravi: privacy concerns. we must redact PII by default.

anya: planned: opt-in per-tenant, default redaction of prompt_text/user_id, hashed feature keys.

luis: avoid blocking request path: return explain_id sync and persist blob async. keep inline only for small explains.

anya: yep proposal: inline_explain_threshold_ms and sample_rate config; otherwise return explain_id.

maia: what about private/on-prem customers?

anya: support two modes: SaaS ingest or local sink (S3/GCS or DB) with same TTL and retention controls.

sam: adapter contract changes? we have many adapters.

anya: minimal: evaluate(ctx) -> {score, optional explain}. adapters may return reason_tags if no structured explain. runtime handles persistence.

luis: storage cap and retention?

anya: default retention 7d, gzip, trace size cap 64KB, backpressure drops + metric increment.

ravi: also add re-run-on-demand: pull request id, run policy in sidecar with traces to avoid storing full inputs. document caveats about signal freshness.

maia: rollout plan: shadow-only -> opt-in sampling -> internal default -> broader with quotas.

ops-bot: deploybot: trace-ingest canary deployed to staging at 2026-03-22T18:02:11Z :rocket:

sam: please include perf matrix for cpu-proxy, small-gpu, large-gpu, dedicated pool and batching cases.

anya: will add microbench + example curl to fetch explain: curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://console.redwood/trace/{explain_id}

luis: add rehydrate workflow gated by IAM/audit for redacted fields.

anya: will file RFC + PRs: runtime hook, adapter contract, ingest service, admin UI. posting links when ready. thanks for feedback.
